summary: The application logs show several warning events, including elevated response times for GET /orders requests, a drop in the cache hit ratio, and disk usage warnings. Successful orders and health checks are also recorded.

likely_cause.statement: The logs only display warning messages regarding response times, cache hit ratio, and disk usage without showing any actual failures or errors.
assumptions: The elevated response times and low cache hit ratio may be related to resource or load issues.

missing_information: Evidence of failed payments or transactions

severity.reason: The logs contain only warnings and successful operations with no customer-facing failures or errors reported.

troubleshooting_steps.why: To check if response times continue to exceed the 1000ms threshold.
To see if the cache hit ratio recovers above 85%.

escalation.when: Escalate only if warnings escalate to application errors or request failures.

incident_summary: Order service experienced high response times up to 1250ms and a cache hit ratio drop to 78%, accompanied by disk usage warnings at 72%. No transaction failures or errors were observed in the logs.

key_errors.pattern: WARN order-service Response time #ms for GET /orders (threshold #ms)
WARN cache Cache hit ratio dropped to #% (expected > #%)
